title: prunus ilicifolia subsp. occidentalis
intro: Prunus ilicifolia subsp. occidentalis, commonly known as California island cherry, is a plant species native to the Channel Islands in the state of California. It is a deciduous shrub or small tree with a rich history of traditional use by the indigenous Chumash people, who valued its medicinal properties. The health benefits of California island cherry include its potential to support digestive health, immune function, and cardiovascular well-being due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
